title: Make stalled-outcome-poll dispatch test independent of the drain yield clock
outcome: federation_outcome_stalled_poll_does_not_hold_wake_dispatch proves dispatch proceeds while the outcome poll is held using controlled drain time and explicit ownership phases.
acceptance: The test retains its held outcome poll, second appended wake, owned dispatch-pass join and pending==0 assertion, with a controlled yield clock preventing incidental2s exhaustion before the second dispatch.
Production2s yielding, RPC isolation and outcome-poll ownership are unchanged; no retry, ignore or timeout inflation is added.
